verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack addresses licensing, commercial terms, or paid tiers. The only signal is community users saying LM Studio's license or terms of use do not permit work-related use (comm-8, comm-15), which tells a power-user that a restriction exists but not whether a paid license resolves it. missing for 10: first-party license or terms documentation, an explicit statement on commercial/enterprise use, details of any paid or enterprise edition and its pricing, and current independent confirmation of the terms.
